name: create food and water
lore:
# On the Manifestation of Sustenance: *Create Food and Water*

To the uninitiated, this spell is mere utility; to the starving, it is divine grace. When a caster plucks the strings of the Weave, they feel a rhythmic, grounding thrum—akin to the deep pulse of a fertile forest. Visually, the air shimmers with golden, pollen-like motes that coalesce into dense, nutty loaves and cool, crystalline springs. It is not gourmet—the flavor is often likened to damp sawdust and morning dew—but it is life incarnate.

Legend attributes its codification to the **Hermit of the Gilded Sands**. Trapped within a salt-wasted tomb for forty days, he did not pray for gold or escape, but for the "mercy of the crumb." It is said his sheer desperation forced the Weave to yield substance from silence, birthing the first *Manna of the Void*. 

Seekers of the arcane should remember: magic can move mountains, but it is the humble loaf that allows the mountain-climber to endure. Use this gift with reverence, for you are pulling the very vitality of the world into tangible form.
